scope.exposure: Previously inspected development fold; diagnostic is posthoc and conditional on the fitted cell.

fixed_endpoints.mixture_implementation: Apply the existing float64 weighted sum and cast the result to float32, then apply official clipping for scored geometry.

analysis.raw_geometry: Use raw float32 predictions with clipped-label weights.
analysis.scored_geometry: Clip the blended float32 prediction to [-2, 2] after mixing; compare it with clipped B.
reported: Per-target weighted means, variances, covariance and correlation for B, C, fixed B/C mixture and fixed B/A mixture.
Unweighted raw-output means and standard deviations; per-target scored-row prediction clipping fractions.
For each fixed mixture, D=M-B weighted covariance with target and B, residual covariance after linear projection on B, and covariance/variance decomposition identities.
Official score, target scores, and reconstruction from clipped weighted moments by overall scope and fixed position bin.
analysis.empty_bin_policy: Keep zero-row or zero-weight targets explicit; return null geometry and retain the official zero score where the metric defines it.
analysis.uncertainty: No interval: this is descriptive geometry on already graded fitted endpoints.

integrity.prediction_contract: Re-run the frozen panel validator for each arm before loading target arrays; compare all prediction identities and NPY coverage to the frozen F0 grade.
integrity.access: Read-only prediction memory maps; stream one full sequence at a time.
integrity.output: Create-only JSON beneath /home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp; include before/after hashes for all bound inputs.

limitations: No independent-fold, seed, or public-transfer claim.
No causal claim about representation complementarity or standalone C quality.
F2 is excluded until the complete frozen A/B/C panel grader certifies all predictions.
